heading: United States attorneys to represent Indians
lead: In all States and Territories where there are reservations or allotted Indians the United States attorney shall represent them in all suits at law and in equity.

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: “United States attorney” substituted in text for “United States district attorney” on authority of act June 25, 1948. See section 541 of Title 28, Judiciary and Judicial Procedure.
